blurb: An actor that declares an `identity` stands for one particular caller, and the handler reads that identity. A case that acts as the actor must therefore say which caller, as in `by User("bob")`; a bare `by User` leaves the handler nothing to read. A handler that binds its caller (`by c: Caller`) wants the calling context's name the same way. Add the identity. The reverse mistake is `bynk.test.actor_no_identity`.
summary: A test omits the identity an identity-carrying actor requires: a bare call-site `by <Actor>`, or no `by` at all on a handler that binds its `Caller`.
